requirements_summary: Deployment: full Private control plane in customer VPC (no managed outbound internet for model payloads)
Provisioning: Terraform modules + Helm charts; customer wants IaC review before apply
KMS: use customer CMK, support key rotation and grant model; must integrate with Redwood runtime for token encryption and model cache encryption
Audit logging: ship audit logs to customer Splunk/CloudWatch with <10 minute TTL to SIEM; immutable log retention policy required
SSO: Okta SAML; SCIM not required initially but desired later
Data residency: restrict storage and logs to us-east-1; backups encrypted and tagged per project
deployment_plan: POC steps: (1) Deliver Terraform repo + README (branch: pb/poc) for customer review; (2) Customer will run terraform apply in dev account with Redwood-provided IAM role; (3) Deploy Redwood Helm charts to customer EKS/GKE cluster (we recommend EKS) with values file including KMS key arn, no-internet mode, and syslog endpoint; (4) Run smoke tests, then integration tests (latency, throughput, KV cache, audit log delivery); (5) Remediate, finalize security checklist, then sign-off meeting for staging rollout.
acceptance_criteria: All inference traffic stays within customer VPC (no external egress) - validated by network flow logs
Audit logs delivered to customer SIEM within 10 minutes and schema matches agreed format
KMS CMK used for at-rest encryption of both model cache and persisted artifacts; demonstrated key rotation without downtime
P50 latency < 250ms on representative chat workloads; sustain 200 req/s for 10 minutes without errors
Security checklist items (DPA signed, SAML integration successful, SOC2 evidence shared)
integration_tests: End-to-end inference test using clinical-summary prompt set (10k tokens/day equivalent)
KV cache correctness and hit-rate measurement (target > 30%)
Audit log sampling: verify 100% of request/response metadata present and forwarded
KMS encryption/decryption smoke (encrypt a token payload, decrypt using CMK grant)
sign_off_plan: Technical sign-off: SE + customer platform lead validate acceptance criteria in one-hour call; Security sign-off: CISO confirms checklist and DPA attachments; Commercial: finalize estimate and convert to Dedicated/Private contract. Target sign-off week: 2026-03-22.
cost_sensitivity: medium-high - customer expects clear unit economics, wants Optimize recommendations to reduce GPU token cost after baseline POC.
summary: Enterprise biotech prospect evaluating Redwood Private in-customer VPC. POC underway using Terraform + Helm; main risks are legal DPA and VPC networking/firewall config. Technical progress good; schedule sign-off once audit logging and KMS flows are validated.
